description: List information about the FILEs (the current directory by default).

option.name: --all
tip: do not ignore entries starting with .

option.name: --almost-all
tip: do not list implied . and ..

option.name: --author
tip: with -l, print the author of each file

option.name: --block-size
tip: with -l, scale sizes by SIZE when printing them; e.g., '--block-size=M'; see SIZE format below

option.name: --classify
tip: append indicator (one of */=>@|) to entries WHEN

option.name: --color
tip: color the output WHEN; more info below

option.name: --context
tip: print any security context of each file

option.name: --dereference
tip: when showing file information for a symbolic link, show information for the file the link references rather than for the link itself

option.name: --dereference-command-line-symlink-to-dir
tip: follow each command line symbolic link that points to a directory
follow symbolic links listed on the command line

option.name: --directory
tip: list directories themselves, not their contents

option.name: --dired
tip: generate output designed for Emacs' dired mode

option.name: --escape
tip: print C-style escapes for nongraphic characters

option.name: --file-type
tip: likewise, except do not append '*'

option.name: --format
tip: across,horizontal (-x), commas (-m), long (-l), single-column (-1), verbose (-l), vertical (-C)

option.name: --full-time
tip: like -l --time-style=full-iso

option.name: --group-directories-first
tip: group directories before files

option.name: --hide
tip: do not list implied entries matching shell PATTERN (overridden by -a or -A)

option.name: --hide-control-chars
tip: print ? instead of nongraphic characters

option.name: --human-readable
tip: with -l and -s, print sizes like 1K 234M 2G etc.

option.name: --hyperlink
tip: hyperlink file names WHEN

option.name: --ignore
tip: do not list implied entries matching shell PATTERN

option.name: --ignore-backups
tip: do not list implied entries ending with ~

option.name: --indicator-style
tip: append indicator with style WORD to entry names: none (default), slash (-p), file-type (--file-type), classify (-F)
append / indicator to directories

option.name: --inode
tip: print the index number of each file

option.name: --kibibytes
tip: default to 1024-byte blocks for file system usage; used only with -s and per directory totals

option.name: --literal
tip: print entry names without quoting

option.name: --no-group
tip: in a long listing, don't print group names

option.name: --numeric-uid-gid
tip: like -l, but list numeric user and group IDs

option.name: --quote-name
tip: enclose entry names in double quotes

option.name: --quoting-style
tip: use quoting style WORD for entry names: literal, locale, shell, shell-always, shell-escape, shell-escape-always, c, escape (overrides QUOTING_STYLE environment variable)

option.name: --recursive
tip: list subdirectories recursively

option.name: --reverse
tip: reverse order while sorting

option.name: --show-control-chars
tip: show nongraphic characters as-is (the default, unless program is 'ls' and output is a terminal)

option.name: --si
tip: likewise, but use powers of 1000 not 1024

option.name: --size
tip: print the allocated size of each file, in blocks

option.name: --sort
tip: change default 'name' sort to WORD: none (-U), size (-S), time (-t), version (-v), extension (-X), name, width

option.name: --tabsize
tip: assume tab stops at each COLS instead of 8

option.name: --time
tip: select which timestamp used to display or sort; access time (-u): atime, access, use; metadata change time (-c): ctime, status; modified time (default): mtime, modification; birth time: birth, creation; with -l, WORD determines which time to show; with --sort=time, sort by WORD (newest first)

option.name: --time-style
tip: time/date format with -l; see TIME_STYLE below

option.name: --width
tip: set output width to COLS. 0 means no limit

option.name: --zero
tip: end each output line with NUL, not newline
list one file per line

option.name: -c
tip: with -lt: sort by, and show, ctime (time of last change of file status information); with -l: show ctime and sort by name; otherwise: sort by ctime, newest first

option.name: -C
tip: list entries by columns

option.name: -f
tip: same as -a -U

option.name: -g
tip: like -l, but do not list owner

option.name: -l
tip: use a long listing format

option.name: -m
tip: fill width with a comma separated list of entries

option.name: -o
tip: like -l, but do not list group information

option.name: -S
tip: sort by file size, largest first

option.name: -t
tip: sort by time, newest first; see --time

option.name: -u
tip: with -lt: sort by, and show, access time; with -l: show access time and sort by name; otherwise: sort by access time, newest first

option.name: -U
tip: do not sort directory entries

option.name: -v
tip: natural sort of (version) numbers within text

option.name: -x
tip: list entries by lines instead of by columns

option.name: -X
tip: sort alphabetically by entry extension

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
